Nadia: uploaded a new Figma for the inline changelog + undo UX: https://figma.com/file/zzzz9999 (frames: 'Inline Changelog v2', 'Per-step Undo') Rafael: quick summary of intent: show every mutation (promote/scale/rollback) as an inline changelog row under the version with actor, timestamp, and an ephemeral 'Undo' for the last change. helps investigations and reduces reliance on separate audit logs. :mag: Chen: a11y notes: inline rows are fine but must be reachable by keyboard. recommend roving tabindex for the changelog entries and use role="list"/role="listitem" so screen readers treat them as a group. sample approach: ```html
Promoted to 20% by Nadia
``` Ivy: visual pattern for colorblind users: don't rely on yellow/amber alone. add a subtle diagonal hatch pattern behind the 'active' badge and a tooltip that reads 'active canary'. Also include a small label 'active' (not just color) for clarity. Sam: undo semantics: we should allow per-step undo only for the last step on that version (avoid cascading rollbacks). proposal: 30s toast undo + an inline 'Undo' button on the changelog row for 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, show 'Request revert' which opens a rollback proposal flow. Nadia: onboarding microcopy: first-time users see a short tooltip on the Promote button: 'Promote routes traffic to this version. Use Undo within 30s to revert.' this reduces accidental promotes. show a 'Don't show again' checkbox and store preference in user settings. Chen: keyboard shortcut idea: while focus is on a version row, press 'U' to open undo confirmation (if eligible) and 'I' to open the inline changelog. must be discoverable via the keyboard shortcuts modal. ensure modifier-free keys only when focus is on relevant component. Rafael: engineering note: for performance, only mount changelog rows for the last N mutations (e.g., 10) and paginate older entries into a full changelog view. hydrate on demand to keep list light. also debounce UI updates to avoid reordering noise. Ivy: screen reader announcement: when an inline undo appears, announce 'Undo available for 30 seconds for action: promoted to 20% by Nadia'. use aria-live="assertive" sparingly. Sam: one more: animation: show a subtle slide-down when the inline row appears, but respect prefers-reduced-motion. the hatch pattern for colorblind support should be rendered as an SVG background so it scales. Nadia: decisions: implement inline changelog rows (last 10), roving tabindex + list semantics, 30s toast + 3m inline undo button for last step, onboarding tooltip for Promote, colorblind hatch + label, keyboard shortcuts (U/I) scoped to focus, hydrate older entries on demand, reduced-motion support, and screen reader announcements for undo. Rafael/Chen/Sam please add implementation notes to the ticket. I'll update Figma and post frames when done. Thanks! :white_check_mark: deploy-bot: changelog-inline-1767908 created by Nadia at 2026-03-16T08:14:48Z (UI decision recorded).
